headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.7.1-modder.1
summary: Rebased onto upstream 1.7.1 with fixes for the latest Minecraft beta, plus a scrollbar cleanup for the AI provider and model picker dialogs.

items.text: Rebased onto upstream 1.7.1: the crash on the latest Minecraft beta and the network navigation crash are fixed upstream and ship with this build.
The AI provider and model picker dialogs no longer show a second full-height scrollbar next to the list; the list caps its height so the dialog fits short windows and only the list itself scrolls.
